name: Malešov
type: municipality of the Czech Republic; městys
text: Malešov (Czech pronunciation: [ˈmalɛʃof]; German: Maleschau) is a market town in Kutná Hora District in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 1,100 inhabitants. The historic centre is well preserved and is protected as an urban monument zone.

depictions.name: maleshov
depictions.text: (Czech: Malešov) is a village which is located at the southernmost part of the map, slightly southwest of Bylany. it is overlooked by the Maleshov fortress. The village has its own lake, which serves both as a source of water and a defensive barrier on one side of the fortress itself. Aside from the fortress, the village also has its own wooden guard tower on its east side.
